data.name: Perveen
data.gender_notes: Perveen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who sees, observes, and understands deeply. The name Perveen carries the meaning “Seer, Observer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Perveen usually hope their child will grow to embody seer, observer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A guide for the lost souls
data.etymology: Perveen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seer, Observer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Perveen total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
